kind: Synthetic functional contrasts only; not human calibration or solver verification
method: 512 actual legal decisions per row: 4 fixed personality identities ×128 paired decision seeds. Denominator is the fully specified eligible decision, not hands/VPIP. Wilson intervals describe pooled Monte Carlo draws conditional on these four synthetic identities; they are not human-population confidence intervals. Full public prefixes and allowed private actor cards retained.

calibration.disclosure: Synthetic samples may match only the explicitly named synthetic model/check. This is not measured human resemblance, expert review, solver validation or evidence of real-world earnings.

callEvidence.uncertainty: Conditional 95% Wilson sampling interval; 512 eligible opportunities. Fewer than 100 opportunities are insufficient, and an absent/insufficient rate is not 0%. Repeated seeds, shared scenarios and correlated decisions limit independence.
